SELECT ROLE_POS,USER_NAME,ASSET_TYPE,ASSET_SEC_TYPE,TRADE_MARKET,TRADE_DIRECTION,max(AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT) AUTHORIZE_LIMIT_AMT, max(AUTHORIZE_TYPE) AUTHORIZE_TYPE FROM RSK_AUTHORIZE_MNG WHERE AUTHORIZE_TYPE IN (#{AUTHORIZE_TYPE_02}, #{AUTHORIZE_TYPE_03})
AND (TRADE_DIRECTION IS NULL OR TRADE_DIRECTION = #{tradeDirection})
AND (ASSET_SEC_TYPE IS NULL OR ASSET_SEC_TYPE = #{assetSecType})
AND (TRADE_MARKET IS NULL OR TRADE_MARKET = #{tradeMarket})
AND ASSET_TYPE = #{assetType} AND USER_NAME = #{userName} GROUP BY ROLE_POS,USER_NAME,ASSET_TYPE,ASSET_SEC_TYPE,TRADE_MARKET,TRADE_DIRECTION
